## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 1 sept 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Susan Woolley_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "Don't get sucked in. I cancelled this subscription within days of signing up 12 months ago. I have just been slugged over $100 for something that isn't suitable. Support is a joke."
            2. _Martha Webster_, 1 sept 2026, 1/5: "the yoga got too hard for me. I tried to cancel and it had autorenewed before I could get the cancel to work. paid $13 cad for 28 day trial and it renewed for $80. when I contacted them - no refund and just wanted to give me more months."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 13 jun 2026 - 25 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Mel_, 13 jun 2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Patricia Bliss_, 25 ago 2026, 5/5: "At 70, I have lower back, hip & knee issues, I find Tai Chi Chair doable, even while feeling fragile. I also lost 3 pounds just in the first 10 days. Way better than Tai Chi Walking, which I tried first, and ended up hurting in all the above areas after the first session. Tai Chi Chair has not caused any pain, so I can keep on doing the exercises."
<!--/ir-theme-->
